set.body:
While validating bd-01M448BY154ZN24KRJKSBW3YAH on source base a0efebbb with the scoped atlas grouping overlay, a 3 GB warm sbt 1.11.7 server loaded/reloaded the current 350,211-setting graph successfully, then failed while reapplying one atlasJVM / Test / envVars setting. The client returned exit 1 after 42.3 seconds. Logs show 62.5%, 97.8%, and 98.7% GC time, with 0.02 GB free of the 3 GB maximum; the server process was already gone when a targeted recovery kill was attempted. No explicit OutOfMemoryError stack was emitted, so this is a measured settings/GC failure, not a proven exception site.

Reproduction: start the ordinary 3 GB warm server, reload, then set atlasJVM / Test / envVars += ("TEMPLATEFLOW_HOME" -> "/path/to/verified/assets"). No assets or numerical tests are needed to reach settings reapplication. Avoid rerunning this in a busy shared host; use an isolated worktree and bounded process monitoring.

Workaround validated in the atlas slice: start a fresh server with TEMPLATEFLOW_HOME already in the environment; no interactive setting reapplication is needed. Keep that source-level oracle isolation separate from this build-settings issue.

Investigate duplicate external build graphs/settings retention and scoped configuration cost before increasing all heaps. Evidence: docs/verification/atlas-inversion-isolation-20261006/logs-and-sources.tar.gz, setup-attempt/configure.log, runs.json, processes.json. Acceptance: reproduce and qualify a repair or explicit supported resource requirement; preserve pins and test selection; repeated warm commands and scoped setting reapplication succeed with measured heap/RSS and no prolonged GC.
set.title: Warm sbt settings reapplication fails under 3 GB GC pressure
